name: Alex Goyette
bio: Alexandre Marcel Goyette (born October 5, 1988) is an American filmmaker, YouTuber, actor and visual effects artist. He is best known for directing the horror film Breeder (2026).

credits.title: Breeder
credits.overview: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

credits.title: Deep Breaths
credits.overview: A psychologist suffering from an anxiety disorder begins to have a mental breakdown when she hears a sinister voice through her headphones.

credits.title: Halloween, Except the Knife Is 50 Feet Long
credits.overview: Michael Myers stalks his prey with a very, very, very large knife.

credits.title: Under the Stairs
credits.overview: Kate tries to console the crying woman next door through the thin wall, but slowly realizes that might not be her neighbor after all.

credits.title: Expelled
credits.overview: Felix is a legendary prankster who gets expelled from his high school and, with his friend’s help, stops at nothing to hide it from his parents.
